snippet.title: Romancing SaGa -Minstrel Song- Remastered Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A remaster of the 2005 PlayStation 2 remake, Romancing SaGa -Minstrel Song- Remastered features enhanced HD graphics, new playable characters, bosses, numerous enhancements to improve playability, and more!
Learn new techniques or deal greater damage in the heat of battle with the SaGa series trademark elements, such the “Glimmer” and “Combo” mechanics and create your own storyline with the free scenario system to create your own SaGa.
 
Available now on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, Steam and Mobile.
